prompts.prompt: Use the attached company tri-fold brochure ONLY as visual reference, not an edit target. Rich carefully controlled detail, tangible light and depth, luminous blue but not neon purple, small warm gold glints matching original gold lettering. Left upper 55% is a calm deep-blue continuous tonal area for Chinese headline and copy, not a flat empty black rectangle. Full bleed polished commercial brand texture, real usable image, absolutely no sheet of thumbnails, no text or watermark. The attached WQT company tri-fold brochure is the visual reference, not an edit target. Keep upper and middle-left 60% quieter and darker for existing badge and Chinese text to be composed later. Rich tangible depth and detailed light, professionally polished, not a simple flat gradient or a few lines. No words, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no people, no robot, no character, no charts pretending data. One unified image, no montage. Retain original brochure's distinctive blue orbital field and gold accent balance.

Delicate carefully layered dimensional light and fine texture, friendly sophisticated technology-for-children visual identity. Blue #354AAD and electric blue #337CFF, gold #DEB657 in tiny accents only. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, people, robots, charts or thumbnail montage. One unified full-bleed usable brand background.
